note: Provisional MVP acceptance inventory derived from the user's service requirements and issue #222. PO must approve the denominator before this is an official MVP forecast. Repository setup and closed issues are not service acceptance or deployment permission.

criteria.title: Committed checkpoints survive process death with tested recovery
Concurrent clients, forks and store failures preserve documented guarantees
C#/TypeScript/Python contracts and existing stores remain compatible
Client architect can configure and activate service agents
Pause/resume drains or preserves in-flight ownership without loss
Replacement and interrupted shifts resume through audited durable handoffs
Versioned configuration defines bounded workflows and ownership
Optional linked skills/MCPs/tools require explicit permission and fail safely
System-prompt arrangement and hooks have tested precedence and trust boundaries
Service shifts resume priority or select eligible work by priority then age
Daily snapshot publication, offline gaps and overlap are observable
Product goals, ETA assumptions, dependencies and support runway are reviewable
Aspire/emulators/disposable dependencies reproduce the service locally
Every acceptance path has local tests, coverage and per-E2E screenshots
Deployment fails closed without reviewed candidate-specific human approval
PO/Architect approve MVP scope, dependency-complete breakdown and estimates
Team hiring/pausing and workflow customization are a real service walkthrough
Configuration migration, troubleshooting, rollback and support ownership documented

systems.title: Durability / stores
systems.description: Shared checkpoint, fork, transaction and recovery semantics; no scenario-private fork.

systems.title: Runtime / transports / scheduling
systems.description: Lifecycle, admission, process recovery and transport behavior.

systems.title: Language ports
systems.description: Cross-language semantics, store compatibility and parity evidence.

systems.title: Quality and acceptance
systems.description: Local results, coverage, every-E2E screenshots and independent evidence review.

systems.title: Goals / ownership / roadmap
systems.description: Client-architect-configured lifecycle/workflow product scope; ETA/risk and support runway.

systems.title: Readiness and presentations
systems.description: Source freshness, traceable snapshots, meeting preparation and corrective-action closure.

duties.squad: Coordinator: reconcile cross-slice ownership, stale blockers and the admission budget before dispatch and at handoff.
duties.po: PO: approve/version the MVP denominator; update priorities, goal/ETA assumptions and acceptance links each shift.
duties.lead: Architect: maintain system boundaries, technical dependencies and acceptance design; resolve scope/configuration conflicts.
duties.core-engineer: Canvas technical maintainer: local process/restart, source-cache/integration configuration, credential availability, lock recovery and dependency/test maintenance; also own runtime/store evidence.
duties.polyglot-engineer: Update language parity/store-compatibility evidence and cross-port risks after each change.
duties.tester: Publish qualifying local reports, coverage, every-E2E screenshots and independent acceptance records; never infer completion from source presence.
duties.docs: Keep source/runbook links, onboarding and support gaps current; flag missing provenance before presentations.
duties.commitments-facilitator: Canvas accountable operating owner: refresh/publication and freshness, configuration-review scheduling/agenda, missed-run escalation and unresolved owner/deadline/evidence gaps.
duties.scribe: Merge accepted decisions only; notify the facilitator when canonical decision evidence changes. Do not fabricate canvas/meeting records.
duties.ralph: Refresh the authoritative queue before priority/status reporting; flag blockers and ownership conflicts without rewriting acceptance.
duties.rai: Report relevant responsible-AI/content-safety findings and evidence links through governed decisions; do not change completion percentages.
duties.fact-checker: Check canvas claims, source SHA/time, evidence mode and denominator before external presentations; flag unsupported completion claims.
